text:
Designing a reliable file backup system is not merely about copying data from one drive to another; it is about building a **resilience strategy**. A backup is only reliable if it can be verified, restored quickly, and protected from the same threats that affect the primary data.

Below is a comprehensive guide to designing a professional-grade file backup system.

---

### 1. Backup Methodologies: Full vs. Incremental
To manage storage costs and backup windows, you should employ a hybrid approach.

#### Full Backups
A full backup copies every selected file and folder, regardless of whether they have changed.
